# convex_environment_variable (Resource)

Manages an environment variable on a running Convex deployment, through the [Deployment Platform API](https://docs.convex.dev/deployment-platform-api).

This is distinct from `convex_default_environment_variable`, which seeds variables into deployments *created later*. This resource changes a deployment that already exists, which is usually what you want.

Variables the configuration does not declare are left alone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "convex_project" "app" {
  team_id = var.convex_team_id
  name    = "My Application"
}

resource "convex_deployment" "prod" {
  project_id      = convex_project.app.id
  deployment_type = "prod"
  is_default      = true
}

# Sets the variable on the running deployment, taking effect immediately.
#
# Always feed it deployment_url rather than building a URL from the deployment
# name: regional deployments look like
# https://calm-cow-456.eu-west-1.convex.cloud.
resource "convex_environment_variable" "stripe_key" {
  deployment_url = convex_deployment.prod.deployment_url
  name           = "STRIPE_KEY"
  value          = var.stripe_key
}

# Works against a deployment Terraform does not manage, too.
data "convex_deployment" "existing" {
  name = "playful-otter-123"
}

resource "convex_environment_variable" "sentry_dsn" {
  deployment_url = data.convex_deployment.existing.deployment_url
  name           = "SENTRY_DSN"
  value          = var.sentry_dsn
}

# Compare with convex_default_environment_variable, which does not touch any
# existing deployment -- it only seeds deployments created afterwards.
resource "convex_default_environment_variable" "log_level" {
  project_id      = convex_project.app.id
  deployment_type = "prod"
  name            = "LOG_LEVEL"
  value           = "info"
}

variable "stripe_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "sentry_dsn" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_url` (String) Backend URL of the deployment, as reported by `convex_deployment.deployment_url`. Use that attribute rather than building the URL from the deployment name: regional deployments look like `https://calm-cow-456.eu-west-1.convex.cloud`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the environment variable, for example `STRIPE_KEY`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Value of the environment variable. Marked sensitive, since these commonly hold credentials; note that the value is stored in Terraform state either way. Can be changed in place.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Environment variables are imported as "<deployment_url>/<name>". The URL
# contains slashes, so the variable name is taken as the final segment.
terraform import convex_environment_variable.stripe_key 'https://playful-otter-123.convex.cloud/STRIPE_KEY'
```
